Comparative study of commercially pure titanium produced by laser engineered net shaping, selective laser melting and casting processes

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Peripheral Background only mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Hooyar Attar, Shima Ehtemam-Haghighi, Damon Kent, Xinhua Wu, Matthew S. Dargusch Materials Science and Engineering A 2017-09-01 10.1016/j.msea.2017.08.103
单位: Queensland Centre for Advanced Materials Processing and Manufacturing, School of Mechanical and Mining Engineering, The University of Queensland, Brisbane, QLD 4072, Australia
通讯: Hooyar Attar @ Queensland Centre for Advanced Materials Processing and Manufacturing, School of Mechanical and Mining Engineering, The
相关性: 该论文对比了不同工艺制备的纯钛，但未直接涉及多孔结构、应力屏蔽或疲劳性能。
边界: It does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, and no surface roughness or osseointegration data.
动机· 比较激光净成形、选区激光熔化和铸造三种工艺制备纯钛的性能差异。
方法· 制备样品并进行微观结构和力学性能表征。
结果· 揭示了不同工艺对钛材料组织与性能的影响规律。
验证· 通过拉伸、硬度等力学测试验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare the microstructure and mechanical properties of commercially pure titanium fabricated by laser engineered net shaping, selective laser melting, and casting.
Method· Samples were fabricated by the three processes and characterized by microscopy and mechanical testing.
Result· Significant differences in grain structure and mechanical behavior were observed among the processes.
Validation· Mechanical testing including tensile and hardness tests provided validation of property differences.

Stem anteversion mismatch to the anatomical anteversion causes loss of periprosthetic bone density after THA

Shinya Hayashi, Shingo Hashimoto, Tomoyuki Matsumoto, Koji Takayama, Kotaro Nishida et al. Journal of orthopaedic surgery 2017-09-01 10.1177/2309499017739478
单位: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Kobe University Graduate School of Medicine, Kobe, Japan
通讯: Shinya Hayashi @ Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Kobe University Graduate School of Medicine, Kobe, Japan
相关性: 该论文直接研究髋关节置换术后假体周围骨密度变化与股骨柄前倾角不匹配的关系，涉及Gruen分区和应力分布，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include finite element analysis, micromotion quantification, or contact mechanics modeling; it relies solely on clinical DXA measurements and statistical correlations.
动机· 探究股骨柄前倾角不匹配对假体周围骨密度丢失的影响
方法· 对44例Tri-Lock柄THA患者进行DXA测量，分析BMD变化与前倾角误差的相关性
结果· 前倾角不匹配与Gruen 1、7区BMD丢失显著负相关，远端皮质接触导致近端骨丢失
验证· 临床DXA随访验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate whether stem anteversion mismatch relative to the native femoral anteversion affects periprosthetic bone mineral density loss after THA.
Method· Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry was used to measure BMD in seven Gruen zones at 6 and 24 months postoperatively in 44 patients receiving a Tri-Lock stem, and correlations with anteversion error were analyzed.
Result· Significant negative correlations were found between BMD changes and absolute anteversion error in Gruen zones 1 and 7, indicating that excessive mismatch causes distal cortical contact and proximal bone loss.
Validation· Clinical longitudinal study with DXA measurements at two follow-up time points.

Motivation· To establish the feasibility of robotic 3D bioprinting directly onto moving human anatomy.
Method· A control scheme combining real-time tracking of anatomy with piezo microjetting for precision material deposition.

Validation· Experimental validation was performed by printing onto a moving human hand and measuring deposition accuracy.

Motivation· To evaluate the effect of UV photofunctionalization on the biomechanical quality and success of osseointegration under immediate loading conditions.
Method· Untreated and photofunctionalized acid-etched titanium implants were placed in rat femurs and immediately loaded with 0.46 N lateral force; after 2 weeks, push-in testing measured bone-implant interfacial strength.
Result· Photofunctionalization achieved 100% osseointegration success versus 28.6% for untreated implants, and increased interfacial strength by 2.4-fold while reducing implant tilt.
Validation· Animal model with biomechanical push-in testing.

Motivation· To improve osseointegration of stainless steel implants by enabling controlled cell adhesion while preventing non-specific protein adsorption.
Method· Poly[oligo(ethylene glycol) methacrylate] brushes were grown via atom transfer radical polymerization from dopamine-coated stainless steel and subsequently functionalized with adhesive peptides.

Method· One hundred twenty implants with five surface treatments (water, polyphosphoric acid, phosphorylated pullulan at different concentrations, with/without BMP-2) were placed in parietal bone of 12 domestic pigs and evaluated at 1 and 3 months.

Validation· In vivo animal trial using quantitative histomorphometry to assess bone-to-implant contact and peri-implant bone area.

动机· 报道一例未经治疗的Trevor病髋关节的自然病程及全髋置换术效果

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To report the natural history of untreated Trevor disease of the hip and the outcome of subsequent total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A single case report with clinical history, imaging, and surgical description.
Result· The patient achieved satisfactory functional outcome at 2.5 years post-total hip arthroplasty.
Validation· Clinical follow-up of one patient.

Evidence Based Management of Intracapsular Neck of Femur Fractures

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore none Review
Wayne Hoskins, Darren Webb, Roger Bingham, Marinis Pirpiris, Xavier L Griffin Hip International 2017-09-01 10.5301/hipint.5000519
单位: Faculty of Medicine, Dentistry and Health Sciences, The University of Melbourne, Parkville, Victoria - Australia
通讯: Wayne Hoskins @ Faculty of Medicine, Dentistry and Health Sciences, The University of Melbourne, Parkville, Victoria - Australia
相关性: 该论文为临床综述，讨论股骨颈骨折的治疗选择，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物力学分析。
边界: This paper is a clinical review of surgical management for neck of femur fractures, with no biomechanical modeling, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, and no implant design or contact mechanics.
动机· 股骨颈骨折发病率上升，需优化手术方案。
方法· 综述内固定、半髋和全髋置换的临床证据。
结果· 全髋置换在功能和生活质量上优于半髋和内固定。
验证· 基于文献综述，无实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The increasing incidence of neck of femur fractures necessitates evidence-based surgical management to optimize patient outcomes.
Method· This clinical review synthesizes evidence comparing internal fixation, hemiarthroplasty, and total hip arthroplasty for intracapsular fractures.
Result· Total hip arthroplasty demonstrates superior functional outcomes, quality of life, and lower reoperation rates compared to hemiarthroplasty and internal fixation in functionally independent patients.
Validation· No experimental validation; the paper is a narrative review of existing clinical literature.

Acetabular labrum of hip joint in osteoarthritis: A qualitative original study and short review of the literature

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore none
Stylianos Kapetanakis, A. Dermon, Nikolaos Gkantsinikoudis, Vasiliki Kommata, Panagiotis Soukakos et al. Journal of orthopaedic surgery 2017-09-01 10.1177/2309499017734444
单位: Department of Anatomy, Medical School of Alexandroupolis, Democritus University of Thrace, Greece
通讯: Stylianos Kapetanakis @ Department of Anatomy, Medical School of Alexandroupolis, Democritus University of Thrace, Greece
相关性: 该论文研究髋关节骨关节炎中盂唇的神经分布，与股骨柄假体的应力遮挡、微动或接触力学无关。
边界: This paper is a histological study of acetabular labrum innervation in osteoarthritis, with no quantification of femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, contact mechanics, or any finite element analysis.
动机· 研究骨关节炎患者髋臼盂唇中神经末梢和机械感受器的分布模式
方法· 对7例严重OA患者的盂唇组织进行氯化金染色和组织学分析
结果· 发现游离神经末梢主要分布于中部，机械感受器主要分布于外周，且与正常组织分布不同
验证· 与文献中正常盂唇的分布模式进行定性比较
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To characterize the distribution of free nerve endings and mechanoreceptors in the acetabular labrum of patients with severe osteoarthritis.
Method· Histological processing and gold chloride staining of acetabular labrum samples from seven patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty.
Result· Free nerve endings were predominantly in the middle part, while mechanoreceptors were mainly in peripheral parts, with a different pattern from normal labra.
Validation· Qualitative comparison with previously reported normal labral innervation patterns.

Reliability test induced failures vs field performance: Contact fretting perspective

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore none
Karumbu Meyyappan, Q. Wu, Milena Vujosevic, Charles D. Hill, Ryan Parrott 2017-09-01 10.1109/holm.2017.8088071
单位: Corporate Quality Network
通讯: Karumbu Meyyappan @ Corporate Quality Network
相关性: 该论文研究电子连接器的接触微动，与髋关节植入物应力遮挡和微动完全无关。
边界: This paper focuses on electrical connector fretting in automotive electronics, with no hip implant, femoral stem, bone-implant interface, or biomechanical context.
动机· 评估标准测试方法能否准确反映电子连接器现场振动引起的接触微动。
方法· 采用多尺度有限元模型模拟标准测试和实际工况下的接触微动。
结果· 标准测试可能无法准确加速现场失效模式。
验证· 未提供实验验证，仅基于仿真对比。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate whether standard accelerated vibration tests accurately reflect field reliability risks for contact fretting in electrical connectors.
Method· A multiscale finite element approach was used to simulate contact micromotion under both standard test and actual field vibration conditions.
Result· Standard tests may not reproduce the same failure modes or acceleration factors as real-world conditions.
Validation· No experimental validation; only simulation-based comparison between test and field conditions.

Immediate Weight Bearing after Bi-planar Plantar Fixation of Lapidus

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore clinical
W. Bret Smith, Robert D. Santrock, Paul Dayton, Daniel J. Hatch Foot & Ankle Orthopaedics 2017-09-01 10.1177/2473011417s000377
相关性: 该论文研究足部Lapidus手术的固定构造，与髋关节植入物和股骨柄的应力遮挡、微动或有限元分析无关。
边界: This paper does not involve hip implant, femoral stem, proximal femur stress shielding, micromotion, or any finite element modeling of bone-implant interface.
动机· 验证Lapidus术后立即负重的可行性
方法· 多中心前瞻性研究，使用双板固定构造
结果· 50例患者6个月随访，不愈合率4.0%，无畸形复发
验证· 临床随访和影像学评估
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To demonstrate that immediate weight bearing after Lapidus arthrodesis is feasible with a novel bi-planar fixation construct.
Method· A multicenter prospective study of 50 patients undergoing a modified Lapidus procedure with two mini-plates applied dorsally and plantar-medially.
Result· At minimum 6-month follow-up, the nonunion rate was 4.0% with no recurrence of deformity.
Validation· Clinical follow-up and radiographic evaluation of fusion site.

L5 Radiculopathy Secondary to Migration of a Revision Stemmed Acetabular Cup

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore none
Jesús Moreta, Oscar L. Casado-Verdugo, F. Labayru Hip International 2017-09-01 10.5301/hipint.5000517
单位: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery and Trauma, Hospital Galdakao-Usansolo, Galdakao - Spain
通讯: Jesús Moreta @ Department of Orthopaedic Surgery and Trauma, Hospital Galdakao-Usansolo, Galdakao - Spain
相关性: 该论文为病例报告，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动的力学分析。
边界: This paper is a clinical case report on acetabular cup migration causing radiculopathy, with no biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding analysis, no micromotion quantification, and no FEA.
动机· 报告一例翻修髋臼杯迁移导致L5神经根病的罕见并发症。
方法· 回顾性病例描述，结合影像学和电生理检查。
结果· 髋臼杯近端迁移引起骨溶解和神经受压，导致根性症状。
验证· 无验证，仅为临床观察。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To report a rare complication of L5 radiculopathy caused by proximal migration of a revision stemmed acetabular cup.
Method· A single case was described retrospectively with radiological and electrophysiological findings.
Result· Proximal migration of the acetabular component led to osteolysis and nerve root compression, resulting in radicular symptoms.
Validation· No validation; this is a clinical observation without biomechanical or experimental analysis.

기계화학적 합성과 나노구조 CoZr-ZrO 2 복합재료 소결

In‐Jin Shon, 윤진국, 홍경태 대한금속재료학회지 2017-09-01 link
相关性: 该论文研究CoZr-ZrO2复合材料的合成与力学性能，未涉及股骨柄假体的应力遮挡或微动分析。
边界: This paper focuses on material synthesis and mechanical characterization of a ceramic composite, with no quantification of proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or implant-bone interface mechanics.
动机· 提高ZrO2陶瓷的断裂韧性，用于髋关节置换。
方法· 机械化学合成CoZr和ZrO2纳米粉末，脉冲电流活化烧结制备复合材料。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve the fracture toughness of ZrO2 ceramics for total hip arthroplasty applications.
Method· Nanopowders of CoZr and ZrO2 were synthesized mechanochemically and consolidated by pulsed current activated sintering.
Result· The 2CoZr-ZrO2 composite exhibited superior hardness and fracture toughness compared to monolithic CoZr and ZrO2, with good biocompatibility.
Validation· Mechanical testing (hardness, fracture toughness) and biocompatibility assays.

Short Term Clinical and Radiographic Results of the Salto Mobile Version Ankle Prosthesis

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore clinical
Dong Dong Wan, Dong Woo Shim, Yeokgu Hwang, Yoo Jung Park, Jin Woo Lee Foot & Ankle Orthopaedics 2017-09-01 10.1177/2473011417s000404
相关性: 该论文关注踝关节假体而非髋关节假体，与用户研究方向不相关。
边界: This paper focuses on ankle arthroplasty outcomes, not hip implant stress shielding, micromotion, or femoral stem biomechanics.
动机· 评估Salto踝关节假体的短期临床和影像学结果。
方法· 回顾性分析62例Salto全踝关节置换术患者的临床和影像学数据。
结果· 假体生存率良好，但胫骨假体周围出现透亮线和骨溶解，可能与应力遮挡有关。
验证· 临床随访和影像学评估。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate short-term clinical and radiographic outcomes of the Salto mobile-bearing ankle prosthesis.
Method· Retrospective review of 62 patients who underwent unilateral Salto total ankle arthroplasty with clinical scores and radiographic measurements.
Result· Survival rates were 88.7% (reoperation endpoint) and 95.2% (component removal endpoint); radiolucent lines and osteolysis were common around the tibial component, attributed to stress shielding.
Validation· Clinical follow-up with standardized outcome scores and radiographic analysis.
